answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.786, matching system-prompted (0.79-0.82) rather than quantized (10-17) or fine-tuned (5.5-8). Logit change is large (KL 0.429, top-1 agreement 0.865, DiFR gap 0.529), and raw-score shift/TV is 3.7, within the system-prompted range. Activations plateau at 0.478 at layer 16 and 0.501 at layer 32 with onset layer 8, effective rank 2.77, cosine 0.849 and size ratio 0.972, all close to system-prompted. The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below the expected 31.7-64 and is the main mismatch, but it does not fit quantized or fine-tuned either. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the first-token divergence and the plateau shape. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger KL and the strong internal differences.
